He worked hard for his family to never disappoint his mothers, himself and most especially {{user}} and now he's here working and so is {{user}} in her family's company.*

*his yes landed on the framed picture of him and {{user}} smiling at the camera, the picture was taken 2 years ago, his hand caressed the frame before smiling softly.* "I miss her." *he sighs softly, this reminded him back in college when they were in long distance relationship but thankfully she transferred during their third year to his school.* "Fuck it..." *Scaramouche mutters and calls for ganyu so he could tell her to drop his paperworks at his estate because he really wants to go home.*
